from rest_framework import viewsets, permissions
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .models import WarehouseDatabaseConnector
from .serializers import WarehouseConnectorSerializer

class WarehouseConnectorViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = WarehouseConnectorSerializer
    queryset = WarehouseDatabaseConnector.objects.all()

    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
    def export_connection_uri(self, request, pk=None):
        # encrypted_connection_dsn is an EncryptedTextField
        connector = self.get_object()
        return Response({
            "connector_id": connector.id,
            "engine": connector.engine_type,
            "decrypted_dsn": connector.encrypted_connection_dsn
        })
